scope: Review aid, no automated creative verdict

timeline.visible_change: The moving rotor physically stops; its status light turns copper.
timeline.viewer_reward: A small failure becomes a visible physical problem.
timeline.continuity_from: Start on the subject already moving.
timeline.sound_action: The existing motor decays into a short stop.

timeline.visible_change: The close pump opens onto three connected branches and houses.
timeline.viewer_reward: The viewer discovers that the failed pump serves a larger system.
timeline.continuity_from: Keep the same stopped rotor in frame.
timeline.sound_action: A short pipe resonance accompanies the newly exposed branches.

timeline.visible_change: Copper warnings travel from the failed pump along the three branches.
timeline.viewer_reward: A local fault can become a connected consequence.
timeline.continuity_from: Follow the pipes exposed by the pullback.
timeline.sound_action: A muted transmission pulse follows the branching warning.

timeline.visible_change: A Texas locator opens below the network and highlights College Station.
timeline.viewer_reward: The viewer connects the illustration to the specific Texas research project.
timeline.continuity_from: The same network anchors the new context.
timeline.sound_action: Leave room for the spoken institution and location.

timeline.visible_change: A small source slip opens across the lower pipes with the dated project start.
timeline.viewer_reward: The date belongs to a research award and not to a utility rollout.
timeline.continuity_from: Keep the physical network behind the source slip.
timeline.sound_action: Use a quiet paper movement beneath the voice.

timeline.visible_change: A wireframe copy separates below the stopped physical pump.
timeline.viewer_reward: The digital twin represents the physical system without claiming deployment.
timeline.continuity_from: The second rotor preserves the original pump silhouette.
timeline.sound_action: A restrained glass tone marks the model separating.

timeline.visible_change: Dashed connectors appear between the physical pump and its research twin.
timeline.viewer_reward: The viewer sees which real object the model would represent.
timeline.continuity_from: Keep both pumps visible while the connection completes.
timeline.sound_action: Let the music carry this connection without another impact.

timeline.visible_change: A sensor trace drops in and connects to the wireframe model.
timeline.viewer_reward: A model needs observations from the physical network.
timeline.continuity_from: Follow the connector into the existing twin.
timeline.sound_action: A single muted data tick marks the arriving sensor trace.

timeline.visible_change: A rain icon opens beside the sensor and feeds the same model.
timeline.viewer_reward: Weather adds context to the sensor input.
timeline.continuity_from: Keep the existing sensor path visible.
timeline.sound_action: Use a light texture below the narrated weather input.

timeline.visible_change: A maintenance record joins the other inputs and connects to the twin.
timeline.viewer_reward: Operational history adds context to the proposed model.
timeline.continuity_from: Complete the three-input group above the same twin.
timeline.sound_action: A soft paper tick marks the record arriving.

timeline.visible_change: The wireframe network begins a copper fault trace.
timeline.viewer_reward: The model illustrates a possible chain of failures.
timeline.continuity_from: Carry the input paths into the same model.
timeline.sound_action: A short tracking sound follows the warning route.

timeline.visible_change: The trace reaches the remaining branches and their endpoint warnings.
timeline.viewer_reward: The consequence spreads beyond the original fault.
timeline.continuity_from: Complete the trace already moving along the pipes.
timeline.sound_action: Resolve the tracking sound as the endpoint warnings light.

timeline.visible_change: The original network gives way to an editorial layout of the NSF award.
timeline.viewer_reward: The viewer can inspect what the source actually claims.
timeline.continuity_from: The proposed twin motivates a check of the primary evidence.
timeline.sound_action: A quiet paper turn introduces the source.

timeline.visible_change: An underline draws beneath the source phrase support research.
timeline.viewer_reward: The award funds research; it does not describe a proven rollout.
timeline.continuity_from: Read the same source page as its key phrase is marked.
timeline.sound_action: Leave this emphasis to the narrator instead of adding a whoosh.

timeline.visible_change: The claim fades and an empty measurement field opens on the page.
timeline.viewer_reward: The evidence has a visible limit.
timeline.continuity_from: Keep the source page and replace its claim with the unanswered test.
timeline.sound_action: A small paper movement reveals the blank field.

timeline.visible_change: The empty field resolves to the finding Not reported in this award.
timeline.viewer_reward: The viewer gets a clear answer about measured improvements.
timeline.continuity_from: Fill only the source-limit finding in the same measurement field.
timeline.sound_action: Use a brief musical rest to make the limit legible.

timeline.visible_change: A laptop and guidance booklet move into the operator workspace.
timeline.viewer_reward: The proposed research has a planned path toward human use.
timeline.continuity_from: Match the model silhouette inside the laptop screen.
timeline.sound_action: A soft desk contact grounds the tools in a workspace.

timeline.visible_change: A hand enters and reaches toward the proposed tool.
timeline.viewer_reward: The human use of the research becomes visible.
timeline.continuity_from: Keep the laptop and guidance booklet in place.
timeline.sound_action: Use a restrained contact sound under the voice.

timeline.visible_change: The workspace cuts back to the original stopped pump in close view.
timeline.viewer_reward: The real physical system remains the test of the research.
timeline.continuity_from: Match the round pump from the laptop to the opening machine.
timeline.sound_action: Let the room tone return and reduce the musical density.

timeline.visible_change: Test brackets resolve around the physical pump with the field-evidence limit.
timeline.viewer_reward: The opening question resolves without claiming an unproven benefit.
timeline.continuity_from: Hold the same stopped pump inside the test brackets.
timeline.sound_action: Resolve the music softly into the credit tail.
